## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-measurement-capsules`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-measurement-capsules -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `data/batches.parquet`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `verify.py`
- `latest.json`
- `croissant.json`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `v0.2/index.json`
- `v0.2/anchors.json`
- `v0.2/index.json.ots`
- See the Data tab for all 68 files.

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/measurement-capsules at revision `e52b6e9788c42513d510f3dc439a45b145dc7f4d`, made 2026-10-15. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

## Signed measurement capsules — v0.2 snapshot

This package mirrors the 26 September 2026 capsule index and its supporting records. A capsule describes one instrument's observation about one subject at one time, including its declared value, observed value, limitations and state. Batch records bind capsule identifiers through a Merkle root; the daily index binds the batches.

**Publication erratum:** the files' `private_until: "owner approves publication"` field was superseded by `v0.2/publication/2026-09-26-erratum.json` after publication was approved. That erratum does not change capsule content or signatures.

Start with `data/capsules.parquet` for observations and `data/batches.parquet` for batch context. Read the original signed records, timestamp status and verification instructions in the downloaded `README.md`. A signature establishes integrity of the signed statement; it is not certification or proof that an external subject is safe. The previous page was truncated; the complete source remains at the pinned revision below.

[Complete source README at the mirrored revision](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/measurement-capsules/blob/e52b6e9788c42513d510f3dc439a45b145dc7f4d/README.md).
